concerns.text: T024 (train_fim.py) and T026 (train_nl_control.py) are listed as implementation tasks, but there is no task to generate the 'Baseline' model (no mid-training) required by FR-004 and SC-001. The evaluation phase (Phase 5) depends on three models (FIM, NL-Control, Baseline), but the Baseline producer is missing from the task list, creating a consumer-before-producer violation for T033.

T018 implements 'overlap check logic' but there is no task to execute this check as a blocking gate before T019 (dataset generation) or T024 (training). FR-001 mandates the build MUST fail if overlap > 0. Without a task to run this check and halt the pipeline, the dependency flow allows training to proceed on potentially leaked data.

T018 mentions checking 'GSM8K (train) and LogiQA (test) examples' but omits the specific validation against 'intermediate caches' required by FR-001. The data-flow dependency for the 'intermediate caches' artifact is not explicitly addressed in the task description, risking a missing validation step in the pipeline.

T034 and T035 describe statistical analysis generically ('compare groups'). FR-005 and SC-002 require comparing FIM against *both* NL-Control and Baseline. The task descriptions do not explicitly mandate the inclusion of the Baseline in the t-test/Wilcoxon calculation, creating a risk that the consumer (evaluation) will not receive the required multi-group comparison data.

The Constitution (Principle VII) and Plan require 'format-based leakage verification' to ensure the pseudo-code structure does not encode test-set info. Phase 3 lacks a specific task to perform this verification on the generated pseudo-code structure, relying only on the example overlap check (T018). This missing producer task means the downstream validation (if any) has no input.

SC-005 requires measuring the 'rate of successful dependency graph construction'. T020 implements a 'depth-distribution validator' but does not include a task to calculate and report the success rate metric (successful_graphs / total_examples). The data-flow for this specific metric is broken.
